title: PAN
text:
These details can be obtained from the Income Tax Office or IT PAN Service Centers managed by UTIITSL/Protean or UTIITSL website www.utiitsl.com or Protean website www.tinpan.proteantech.in
[ 11. Representative Assessee/ Authorized Representative Name](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_95-form-96.html#34)
[ 12. Permanent Account Number (if any)](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_95-form-96.html#35)
PAN of Representative Assessee/Authorized Representative is to be given. [ 13. Aadhaar Number/Foreign Passport](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_95-form-96.html#36)
Aadhaar number is mandatory, if PAN of Representative Assessee/Authorized Representative is not available. In case of FPIs, Foreign Passport number can be given if PAN and Aadhaar are not available. [ 14. Address of Representative Assessee/Authorized Representative](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_95-form-96.html#37)
It is mandatory to provide details of Representative Assessee/Authorized Representative having Indian address (except FPIs). FPIs can provide foreign address. [ 15. Contact Details of Representative Assessee/Authorized Representative](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_95-form-96.html#38)
All contact details of Representative Assessee/Authorized Representative are mandatory.
